How it works

Two sides, one short path each.

Freelancers build a profile and get found. Employers browse and send a hire request.

The paths
For freelancers

  1. Create your account

    Choose freelancer, add your skills and the role title you want to be known by.

  2. Make your resume

    Enter your information and AI places it in a ready template.

  3. Post and get requests

    Publish your profile. Employers send hire requests straight to your inbox.

For employers

  1. Log in as an employer

    Browse by skill and read each freelancer's portfolio before you reach out.

  2. Send a hire request

    Describe the work, hours and budget. The freelancer accepts or replies.

  3. Confirm and pay

    See the fee before you confirm. Payment is tied to the hire.

Who can post a portfolio?

Any freelancer with an account. You add a link to your own website or upload your work.

What do employers see?

Your profile, your resume and your portfolio link.

Is the AI resume creator included?

Yes. It is part of every freelancer account.

When is the fee charged?

When a hire is confirmed. Both sides see the fee before they confirm.

Fees

Free to join. A commission only when a hire happens.

The exact percentage is still to be set. The layout shows where it will appear.

What it costs
FreelancersFree

Profile, AI resume creator and portfolio listing. No listing fee.

EmployersFree

Browse talent, read portfolios and send hire requests at no cost.

Per hireCommission

A percentage of the agreed work, shown to both sides before the hire is confirmed.

When do I pay the commission?

Only when a hire is confirmed. Nothing is charged for creating a profile or sending a request.

Will I see the fee in advance?

Yes. Both the freelancer and the employer see it before confirming the hire.
